title: Sheep reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- book -->
  <rect x="28" y="68" width="44" height="22" rx="3" fill="#8B4513"/>
  <!-- book pages left -->
  <rect x="31" y="70" width="18" height="18" rx="2" fill="#FFF8DC"/>
  <!-- book pages right -->
  <rect x="51" y="70" width="18" height="18" rx="2" fill="#FFF8DC"/>
  <!-- book spine -->
  <rect x="47" y="68" width="6" height="24" rx="1" fill="#A0522D"/>
  <!-- book text lines -->
  <line x1="34" y1="74" x2="46" y2="74" stroke="#CCBB99" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="34" y1="78" x2="46" y2="78" stroke="#CCBB99" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="34" y1="82" x2="46" y2="82" stroke="#CCBB99" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="54" y1="74" x2="66" y2="74" stroke="#CCBB99" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="54" y1="78" x2="66" y2="78" stroke="#CCBB99" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="54" y1="82" x2="66" y2="82" stroke="#CCBB99" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- sheep body (fluffy wool) -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="52" r="22" fill="#F5F0E6"/>
  <circle cx="32" cy="45" r="13" fill="#EDE8DF"/>
  <circle cx="68" cy="45" r="13" fill="#EDE8DF"/>
  <circle cx="38" cy="33" r="12" fill="#F5F0E6"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="33" r="12" fill="#F5F0E6"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="30" r="13" fill="#EDE8DF"/>
  <!-- wool texture bumps -->
  <circle cx="35" cy="55" r="8" fill="#EBE5DA"/>
  <circle cx="65" cy="55" r="8" fill="#EBE5DA"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="42" r="9" fill="#F8F5EF"/>
  <!-- sheep face -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="38" rx="12" ry="10" fill="#4A3728"/>
  <!-- sheep eyes -->
  <circle cx="45" cy="35" r="2.5" fill="#1A0F08"/>
  <circle cx="55" cy="35" r="2.5" fill="#1A0F08"/>
  <circle cx="45.8" cy="34.2" r="0.9" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="55.8" cy="34.2" r="0.9" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- sheep nose -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="41" rx="2.5" ry="1.8" fill="#2E1F14"/>
  <!-- sheep mouth - small smile -->
  <path d="M47 43 Q50 46 53 43" fill="none" stroke="#2E1F14" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- sheep ears -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="34" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#4A3728" transform="rotate(-20 36 34)"/>
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="34" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#4A3728" transform="rotate(20 64 34)"/>
  <!-- front hoof holding book left -->
  <rect x="33" y="66" width="7" height="6" rx="2" fill="#3D2B1F"/>
  <!-- front hoof holding book right -->
  <rect x="60" y="66" width="7" height="6" rx="2" fill="#3D2B1F"/>
  <!-- little legs -->
  <rect x="40" y="66" width="5" height="8" rx="2" fill="#3D2B1F"/>
  <rect x="55" y="66" width="5" height="8" rx="2" fill="#3D2B1F"/>
</svg>
